name: garage_vent_cap
note: SHIPPED v4. MaintenanceBay weather cap. Throat collar + arched underside + 46 mm vertical drip band + CONVEX crown (slope grows 0.013 -> 4.4 outward). v1 smooth domed lens read as a contact lens; v2 added a centre boss that read as a nipple; v3 paired a flat brim with a steeper conical crown - crisp head-on but the elevated ASSEMBLY preview showed it as a bowl, which is the same wrong read the original outward-flaring cylinder had. BASELINE CORRECTION (critic pass): the shipped cylinder this replaces has TEN radial segments, not sixteen; the spec previously declared 16 and so measured drift against a baseline that was never in the tree. Re-run against the true 10-segment before, the harness reports 26.92 mm (cap) / 20.56 mm (stack) on one lateral axis - that is the 16-gon landing a vertex on an axis where the 10-gon leaves a flat, i.e. the faceted hull growing toward the nominal circle, not the part growing. Nominal max radius and the Y range are bit-exact, and the vent group at [2.8, 7.05, -1.2] has nothing adjacent on that roof, so the facet-hull delta is not a placement drift.
